Type.title: Restriction type
Type.description:
Restriction type.

Stay (Guests can't stay within specified dates.)

Start (Guests can't check in within specified dates.)

End (Guests can't check out within specified dates.)

ExactRateId.description: Unique identifier of the exact `Rate` to which the restriction applies.

BaseRateId.description: Unique identifier of the base `Rate` to which the restriction applies.

RateGroupId.description: Unique identifier of the `Rate group` to which the restriction applies.

ResourceCategoryId.description: Unique identifier of the `Resource category` to which the restriction applies.

StartUtc.description: Start date of the time interval for which the restriction conditions should be applied. This must be in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format - see [Datetimes](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/serialization#datetimes).

EndUtc.description: End date of the time interval for which the restriction conditions should be applied. This must be in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format - see [Datetimes](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/serialization#datetimes).

Days.title: Days parameters
Days.description: The days of week to which the restriction applies.
